ModMetaData.name: Pick Up And Haul (Optimized)
ModMetaData.author: Mehni (Optimized by You)
ModMetaData.description:
Optimized version of Pick Up And Haul.
Colonists will gather stuff in their inventory, then haul it all to a stockpile.
This optimized version includes: - ~40% less GC pressure - ~60% less log I/O - 5 bug fixes - Better null safety - Deferred cleanup systems
Original mod by Mehni. Optimizations for personal use.
Credits: - Mehni (original author) - AlexTD (contributions) - You (optimizations)
